title: Del Valle Annexation Public Hearing
summary:
*   A special meeting was held, notably with the Mayor and one Councilmember absent.
*   The primary agenda item was a public hearing concerning the limited-purpose annexation of the Del Valle area.
*   Community members attended and filed speaker cards, indicating public engagement on the annexation proposal.
*   No immediate action or policy decision was made regarding the Del Valle annexation following the hearing.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
THURSDAY, MAY 12,1998
Councilmember Slusher called the meeting to order, noting the absence of Mayor Watson and
Councilmember Goodman.
The Public hearing for limited purpose annexation of the Del Valle area will be held at
7:00 p.m. at South Rural Community Center, located at 3518 FM 973 South, Del Valle Texas.
Public hearing held, no action taken
Motion to close public hearing on Council Member Griffith's motion, Council Member
Slusher's second, 5-0 vote, Mayor Watson and Council Member Goodman absent Speaker cards
filed at the City Clerk's Office.
ADJOURNED at 7:45 p.m. on Councilmember Lewis' motion, Council Member Spelman's second, 50
vote, Mayor Watson and Council Member Goodman absent.
Approved the minutes for Regular Meeting of April 30, 1998, Special Called Meeting of May
12, 1998, Worksession of May 13, 1998, and Regular Meeting of May 14, 1998, on this the
21st day of May 1998 on Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion, Council Member Lewis' second, 5-0
vote, Council Members Goodman and Spelman off the dais, Special Called Meeting of April
22,1998, postponed.
